name: cardiac_marker_immunoassay
title: Detection of Cardiac Markers on a Droplet Actuator
protocol_summary: Sample droplet is merged with a magnetically responsive bead reagent (capture antibody + blocking antibody) and incubated to bind the cardiac marker. Unbound material is washed away, a reporter antibody droplet is added and incubated to form the capture-antigen-reporter complex, followed by a repeated merge-and-split wash protocol. The washed bead droplet is combined with a chemiluminescent substrate and the signal is detected on a photomultiplier tube. If the signal exceeds the top of the standard curve, an auto-dilution branch dilutes and re-measures the droplet.
